title: Awards and closing
summary: Brief remarks on awards and thanks to close the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you’ve had quite a few awards over your years, you’ve been part of things that got awards, that’s pretty cool.
Yeah. I think things are starting to happen for me. I’m very pleased about that.
Well I’m glad to hear it. And I enjoyed hearing you.
And on that note, we’ll wrap up and get you to your next gig.
It was a pleasure. I hope that was okay. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -17-
